summary: Frontend-only retest of the /utenti fix. Commercialista sees 'Accesso non consentito'; no GET /api/members or /api/invites requests are made and there are no console errors. Regression for titolare passed: the members list ('Chi ha accesso') loads, members/invites are fetched, and the 'Invita un utente' dialog opens.
critical_code_review_comments: Members.js: hooks are declared before the early return, so hook order is correct. Titolare's members/invites requests fire twice only because React.StrictMode in dev runs effects twice; this is harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 1 covered the full app at 100%. Iteration 2 only checked the role gating on /utenti in Members.js.
